summary: Milestone 5 regression pass with the newly-added RESTRAINT rule. New /app/backend/tests/test_milestone5_instruction_layer.py — 5/5 PASS in 133.7s against the public URL — covers: (1) intervention object shape/type validity + cultural_resource field on every turn, (2) RESTRAINT-still-instructs case (bare topic-announcement thesis 'My essay is about social media and friendship.' -> intervention.type=='instruct_then_invite' with non-empty instruction + named cultural_resource), (3) RESTRAINT-avoids-over-instruction case (sophisticated thesis 'Social media strengthens weak-tie friendships while quietly eroding the close ones, because it rewards breadth over depth.' -> intervention.type in {invite_only, interpretation_only, postpone_instruction}), (4) multi-turn 3-turn flow (writing -> revise -> answer) all under the streaming edge cap with theory_history v1..v3 preserved and prior versions not overwritten, (5) PATCH /api/sessions/{id}/telos updates pedagogical_purpose and persists. Also ran full M1-M4 regression suite (test_developmental_engine + test_milestone2_opening + test_milestone3_thesis + test_milestone4_paragraph) — 42/44 PASS in 741.9s (~12m21s). The two failures are BOTH prompt-size ceiling assertions in older test files (M1 26KB cap, M3 16KB median cap) — this is NOT a functional regression: it's LLM-driven domain-selection variability where the STAGE-A selector picked TWO enriched domains (Central Claim/Thesis + Paragraph Purpose) with 6+6 sections on some turns, pushing reasoner_prompt_bytes to 27582 (peak) and median 17095 over the 8-turn recent window (both slightly above the old assertions but well below the M4 file's 32KB alarm which passes). Iteration 8 already called these out as 'carry-over, non-blocking'. All 4 turns still completed <60s, theory grew correctly, AI never rewrote student text, no stage/score language leaked, intervention.type was valid on every turn, currently_relevant_domains stayed 1-3, RESTRAINT held on capable students. Combined: 47/49 tests pass end-to-end against https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com; NO Milestone 5 regressions.

minor.issue: Reasoner prompt bytes peaked at 27582 (over M1 test file's 26KB assertion) and median 17095 (over M3 test file's 16KB assertion) on turns where BOTH Central Claim/Thesis (~31 keys) AND Paragraph Purpose (~31 keys) were selected together with 5-7 sections each. NOT a functional bug — all turns still completed <60s under the streaming edge cap. Recommendation: raise the M1 ceiling to 30KB and the M3 median cap to 18KB (matching what M4's 32KB/22KB ceiling already tolerates), OR cap sections per enriched domain in _select_relevant_domains to ~4. Same issue was flagged as 'carry-over' in iteration_8.
Returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (carried over from every prior iteration, non-blocking; existing tests assert 200).

rca of the issue: N/A — Milestone 5 acceptance passes end-to-end and no new bugs were introduced. The 2 M1/M3 regression-file failures are pre-existing test-side ceiling assertions being periodically tickled by LLM-driven variability in STAGE-A domain selection (choosing two enriched domains together vs. one enriched + one lightweight). Root cause: three canonical domains (Opening/Introduction, Central Claim/Thesis, Paragraph Purpose) are now enriched to ~31 fields each (~15KB per whole record; ~5-8KB per section-filtered slice); when STAGE A picks two of them on the same turn with 5-7 sections each, the STAGE-B reasoner prompt legitimately grows to 17-28KB. Mitigation options for main agent (all optional): (a) update the two older test files' ceilings to 30KB/18KB to match reality, (b) cap sections-per-domain at 4 in _select_relevant_domains, (c) allow cultural_resources selection for at most one domain per turn.
